title: Cohort Accounting Artifact (Post Corpus Expansion)
description: Strict accounting artifact for the HEADLINE_COHORT_13 cells. Each entry records per-cell admission_status with a typed exclusion_reason for every excluded_* status. The artifact MUST cover every cell in the constant HEADLINE_COHORT_13 set (13 cells) — silent omissions are a contract break. The artifact is produced by tools/sm_86_predictor_accuracy_recovery_v2/build_cohort_accounting.py from data/local_labels/label_admitted.json plus an optional per-cell exclusion-reasons input. The admission_status enum is closed (admitted / excluded_label_repeatability / excluded_label_provenance_duplicate / excluded_join_key_unmatched / excluded_operator_skipped); a status outside this enum is rejected at parse time.

schema_version.description: Pinned at 1. Bumped in lockstep with the tool's emission shape.

cohort_size.description: The HEADLINE_COHORT_13 constant set; the cells array MUST cover exactly this many distinct (slug, shape_point) pairs.

host_arch.description: The host architecture for this round of cohort accounting. Plan 1's scope is sm_86 only; sm_120 is reserved for the Tier-2 cross-arch follow-up loop.

label_admitted_path.description: Repo-relative path to the label_admitted.json file the tool consumed. Records the artifact's input provenance for downstream readers.

label_admitted_schema_version.description: The schema_version pin from the consumed label_admitted.json file. The current pin is 4 (per workloads/simbench_bw/schemas/local_label_admitted.schema.json); the v3-to-v4 migration is enforced at parse time by the admitted-cell schema itself.

cells.description: Per-cell records covering the HEADLINE_COHORT_13 set. minItems=maxItems=13 enforces the all-cell-coverage invariant: every cell in the constant set appears exactly once.

admitted_count.description: Count of cells whose admission_status is admitted. Must match the per-cell records.

predictor_friendly.description: Count of admitted cells in the predictor_friendly bucket (8-cell bucket total).

predictor_hostile.description: Count of admitted cells in the predictor_hostile bucket (5-cell bucket total).

admitted_count_per_bucket.description: Per-bucket admitted counts. Each bucket's count must match the per-cell records' admitted status within that bucket.

slug.description: Kernel slug from the workload roster.

shape_point.description: Shape-file row identifier (e.g. trace_l2_accuracy_xl, timing_shape, correctness_shape).

predictor_design_coverage_bucket.description: Pinned bucket label from comparison_runner._PREDICTOR_DESIGN_COVERAGE_BY_CELL. The contract has 8 friendly + 5 hostile cells totalling 13.

admission_status.description: Closed-enum admission status. admitted: the cell is in data/local_labels/label_admitted.json. excluded_label_repeatability: the NCU sweep ran but the cell's stddev gate (0.03 fraction threshold) rejected. excluded_label_provenance_duplicate: the NCU sweep produced duplicate sidecars for the same (arch, slug, shape_point) cell whose source_commit manifests disagree, so no canonical label can be admitted. excluded_join_key_unmatched: the NCU sweep ran but the join-key fields disagreed with the predictor's manifest_pairing_index. excluded_operator_skipped: the live sweep did not run this round (operator-budget or hardware-availability gap); the cell is honestly reported as not-yet-evaluated. A status outside this enum is a contract break.

exclusion_reason.description: Required when admission_status is any of the three excluded_* values; forbidden when admission_status is admitted. Human-readable typed reason naming the load-bearing detail (e.g., the stddev value that exceeded the gate, the join-key field that drifted, or the operator-budget rationale).

n_repeats.description: Optional: the n_repeats value for admitted cells. Carried verbatim from the label_admitted.json record so the report can audit the repeat floor.

allOf.description: exclusion_reason consistency arm: required when status is excluded_*; forbidden when admitted.
admitted-status arm: exclusion_reason MUST be absent when status is admitted.
